convert_caffe2_cls_model: convert a Caffe2 classification model pickle file to a finetune-ready model by removing metadata and absorbing batch norm layers
remove_spatial_bn_layers: remove spatial batch normalization layers from a Caffe2 model by absorbing running mean and variance into scale and bias parameters
absorb_std_to_conv1: absorb input standard deviation into the conv1 weights for Caffe2 classification model preprocessing normalization
remove_non_param_fields: remove non-parameter fields like epoch, model_iter, and lr from a Caffe2 model weights dictionary
remove_momentum: remove momentum variables ending with _momentum from a Caffe2 model weights dictionary
